#### A fair comparison

A classmate wants to know whether a network of [width](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/neural-nets.html#def-width) 512 classifies the digits better than one of width 8.
They train one of each with [learning rate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-learning-rate) 0.1.
What could make that comparison unfair?
